scope: Concord 3.1.14 dependency adoption and reviewed admission; full acceptance remains separate
source_api_review: Concord 3.1.14 adds optional node-local Turso put_many_if/2 with revision-fenced comparisons and shared publication revisions.
Its 500 total-pair, 16 MiB value and 64 MiB command envelopes honor lower configured caps and one preparation/acquisition/readiness/SQL deadline.
Prefix replacement shares extracted bulk-put validation and preparation; its separate 501 total-pair contract is unchanged.
VSR and ExTurso runtime source is unchanged from 3.1.13; only their package versions change.
ESS retains file-backed VSR, current point Records, its existing list and transaction APIs, and command versions 0/1.
No optional Turso API, command-format migration, dependency patch or relaxed workload limit is enabled.
No reviewed source change establishes a repair for the 3.1.13 index timeout, resource-observation or replica-repair acceptance failures.

bounds.native_scope: owned request PID and single configured local VSR Replica PID; every Core query must be get_record
bounds.peak_heap_method: isolated process total_heap_size plus GC block sizes and 1ms sampling

publication.blocker: The reviewed optional Turso changes do not establish repairs for unresolved index, resource-observation or replica-repair failures; current-source full acceptance remains required.
